scope: Manufacturer register facts and modeling corrections only. No hardware read or write; no calibrated dynamic model.

pwm_slope.interpretation: Voltage-output slew example in PWM mode, not a fixed bus delay or measured torque-rise time. Read actual value; do not impose 18ms on every position command.

current_sensing.torque_inference: Do not apply one stall Nm/A ratio to supply current at every speed; fit measured torque/current/speed.

profile_mode5.status: Documentation inconsistent: Profile Velocity section omits Mode5; trajectory/profile sections include it.
profile_mode5.decision: Record firmware, Drive Mode, Profile Acceleration/Velocity and trajectory registers; verify actual behavior before fitting.
